buildings.name: ocbox CLI
buildings.summary: The ocbox command on a developer's machine. Signs in with OAuth, starts and destroys boxes, syncs local files and runs commands through the hosted API, and can route a coding agent's shell commands into the box.

areas.name: Commands and configuration
areas.summary: Command entry points, project selection, output and runtime composition.

areas.name: Authentication
areas.summary: Browser PKCE login, credential-bound HTTP and serialized token rotation.

areas.name: Session lifecycle
areas.summary: Local Session state and reconciliation with the hosted Session.

areas.name: Command execution
areas.summary: Helper protocol, cancellation, output and command exit codes.

areas.name: Source synchronization
areas.summary: Manifest scanning, planning, archives, hosted push and local recovery.

areas.name: Coding-agent adapters
areas.summary: Owned settings, version gates, setup/remove plans and command hooks.

areas.name: Local state and credentials
areas.summary: Non-secret project metadata and protected credential storage, each locked.

areas.name: Public API client
areas.summary: Generated OpenAPI calls, hosted provider, polling and metadata.

areas.name: Provider contract and fixtures
areas.summary: Capability interface plus contract/fake providers for local validation.

areas.name: Domain and validation
areas.summary: Local specification, Session state, Operation transitions and identifiers.

buildings.name: Local state
buildings.summary: Historical map grouping retained to preserve human notes. Current state and credential code belongs to the ocbox CLI state area; it is not a separately deployed service.

buildings.name: Coding agents
buildings.summary: Claude Code and Codex on the developer's machine. After ocbox agent setup, their Bash tool calls go through an ocbox hook and run in the box instead of locally.

code.name: ocbox start
code.summary: Creates, resumes or reconciles the selected session for this project and waits until the hosted sandbox is ready.

code.name: ocbox exec
code.summary: Runs a program in the selected session. Tokens after -- are sent as an argv array, never through a shell; --shell is the explicit opt-in. Exits with the remote exit code.

code.name: ocbox sync push
code.summary: Applies local-only changes to the session workspace. Deletions need --delete and confirmation.

code.name: ocbox destroy
code.summary: Destroys a session after explicit confirmation and waits for the hosted operation to finish.

code.name: ocbox auth login
code.summary: Signs the CLI in to the hosted API through the browser.

code.name: AuthSessionService.login
code.summary: Binds a loopback listener, opens the authorize URL with a PKCE challenge, waits for the callback, exchanges the code and commits the token pair under the auth gate. Always closes the listener.

code.name: LoopbackCallbackListener
code.summary: One-shot HTTP listener on 127.0.0.1 at /callback that receives the authorization code and checks state.

code.name: codeChallengeS256
code.summary: PKCE S256 challenge from a random verifier, so a stolen code is useless without the verifier kept in memory.

code.name: HostedTokenManager
code.summary: Hands out a valid access token, refreshing when it is about to expire. Rotation happens at most once per generation across processes, so parallel commands don't burn the refresh token.

code.name: HostedOAuthCredentialStore
code.summary: Credential selection port: available OS adapter or protected-file fallback, selected before use. The default runtime wires the protected-file path; project metadata holds only a reference.

code.name: LifecycleStore
code.summary: Atomic JSON store for the selected session and the mapping from local sandbox ids to hosted session ids.

code.name: LifecycleService
code.summary: Session lifecycle on the client: start, stop, destroy and selection, against the configured provider (hosted or fake), with the local store as its memory.

code.name: OcboxSandboxProvider.create
code.summary: Calls createSession for the bound project, polls the returned operation until the sandbox is ready, and saves the hosted session id locally.

code.name: OcboxSandboxProvider.#execute
code.summary: Calls createExecution with an idempotency key. A 404 marks the local mapping stale. Then polls events until the command finishes or the deadline passes.

code.name: runExecutionCommand
code.summary: Parses exec arguments, starts the remote command, streams polled output to stdout and stderr, cancels on interrupt and maps the result to an exit code.

code.name: runSyncApply
code.summary: Plans the sync against the last verified baseline, checks deletions, uploads the archive and records a new baseline only after the hosted apply succeeds.

code.name: scanSourceManifest
code.summary: Walks the project folder with ignore rules and path policy, recording each file's size, mode and SHA-256. Blocks symlinks and paths that escape the root.

code.name: planSync
code.summary: Compares local files with the baseline to decide adds, changes and deletes, so only real changes travel.

code.name: encodeSyncArchive
code.summary: Streams the files into the OCBOXA1 archive format that the hosted API verifies and unpacks.

code.name: uploadPreparedSource
code.summary: Reuses a matching verified manifest if one exists, otherwise creates a manifest, uploads each chunk, verifies the checksum and polls the apply operation.

code.name: createHostedApiClient
code.summary: Generated OpenAPI client with an authenticated transport: adds the bearer token and, for replayable requests only, refreshes once on 401 and retries. Errors stay redacted.

code.name: DEFAULT_API_URL
code.summary: The hosted API the CLI talks to by default: staging until launch.

code.name: runClaudeRoutingHook
code.summary: Reads the agent's PreToolUse JSON. For a covered Bash call it runs the command with ocbox exec in the box, then always answers deny with the remote result as the reason, so the local copy never runs.

code.name: planSetup
code.summary: ocbox agent setup claude-code: writes an owned hook entry into the agent's settings, idempotently, and can be undone with ocbox agent remove.

code.name: AuthSessionService.status
code.summary: Checks credential/metadata identity under the shared state lock; mismatches clear stale state or surface INVALID_STATE.

code.name: AuthSessionService.logout
code.summary: Attempts token revocation, then clears local credentials and metadata even when the network fails; local cleanup failures are reported.

code.name: AuthenticatedHttpClient.request
code.summary: Binds bearer use to API origin and deployment subpath; permits one 401 refresh/retry only for replay-safe requests.

code.name: createSessionGate
code.summary: Serializes login commits, logout, credential reads and refresh across CLI processes using auth.state.lock.

code.name: waitForHostedOperation
code.summary: Polls an operation with validated checkpoints, Retry-After and a default 5-minute deadline; source apply uses a 1-second healthy interval.

code.name: collectExecutionEvents.pollFallback
code.summary: After more than 3 event-page failures, poll execution state (250 ms default), drain remaining events best effort and read terminal result within the original 5-minute deadline.

code.name: OcboxSandboxProvider.#mutate
code.summary: Sends start/pause/stop/destroy against the public API and reconciles the resulting hosted Session under a lifecycle deadline.

code.name: OcboxSandboxProvider.cancelSandboxExecution
code.summary: Finds the active hosted Execution, requests cancellation and waits for a terminal result instead of assuming cancellation succeeded.

code.name: LifecycleService.status
code.summary: Refreshes the selected local Session against provider observations and updates its safe public view.

code.name: LifecycleService.list
code.summary: Returns local Session views; state reads retain the project identity and selected Session.

code.name: LifecycleService.use
code.summary: Selects an existing Session after validating it belongs to the current local project.

code.name: runHostedPush
code.summary: Hosted push refuses remote deletion; scans at most 100 files, 64 KiB each and 512 KiB total, then sends an archive capped at 1 MiB.

code.name: runSyncDiff
code.summary: Builds a read-only comparison against manifests and the verified baseline; hosted capability checks can refuse unsupported operations.

code.name: runSyncRecover
code.summary: Recovers an interrupted local transfer journal under the sync lock; hosted recovery is refused when the capability is absent.

code.name: runExecutionHelper
code.summary: Exec helper validates a protocol request, emits bounded events and turns timeout or interruption into cancellation before its terminal result.

code.name: desiredSessionFragment
code.summary: Build the owned PreToolUse routing fragment for the selected Session. Setup validates version/trust/schema before merging this fragment; no files are written by the planner.

code.name: applyCodexChangePlan
code.summary: Revalidates configuration fingerprints before applying the plan and rolls back written files when a later write fails.

code.name: planMerge
code.summary: Plans an ownership-aware merge of routing hooks and permissions; existing unrelated settings survive, while collisions and ambiguous owned entries are reported.

code.name: parseSettingsJson
code.summary: Parses settings JSON into validated hook/permission records and preserves parse findings instead of trusting malformed agent configuration.

code.name: parseOwnedCodexCommand
code.summary: Recognizes the exact adapter-owned hook command and arguments; unrelated commands do not become removable merely because they mention the CLI.

code.name: resolveCodexPaths
code.summary: Resolves user/project configuration layers and limits owned writes to their permitted roots; project trust is checked separately.

code.name: editTomlHooks
code.summary: editTomlHooks implements agents behavior in src/agents/codex/toml-edit.ts; see the linked area guide for state, capability and failure rules.

code.name: checkCodexVersion
code.summary: Parses and gates the detected version against pinned releases; ambiguous suffixes or unsupported versions produce capability findings.

code.name: resolveExecutableOnPath
code.summary: Resolves executable candidates from PATH and platform extensions without treating an arbitrary existing file as a runnable agent binary.

code.name: mapApiFailureToOcboxError
code.summary: Maps status, public error envelope and safe request/retry metadata to the CLI error catalogue; unexpected raw provider response bytes are not forwarded.

code.name: normalizeIssuer
code.summary: Normalizes the API issuer base and refuses credentialed URLs, fragments or off-loopback cleartext transport before protocol endpoints are derived.

code.name: CliOAuthClient.exchangeAuthorizationCode
code.summary: Posts the authorization code with its original verifier and redirect URI, bounds the response and validates the token pair before storage.

code.name: createHostedTokenManager
code.summary: Public token/authenticated-client ports for the hosted provider (T14). Tokens are read and rotated only through the T3 credential store, behind the cross-process refresh gate, and bound to the configured issuer, client, and credential identity through the machine-level auth metadata.

code.name: createLifecycleService
code.summary: Builds the selected project LifecycleService, local state store and provider registry from validated configuration, flags and API credentials.

code.name: readStandardInput
code.summary: readStandardInput implements commands behavior in src/commands/agent/hook.ts; see the linked area guide for state, capability and failure rules.

code.name: removeCodexLayer
code.summary: removeCodexLayer implements commands behavior in src/commands/agent/remove.ts; see the linked area guide for state, capability and failure rules.

code.name: parseCodexLayer
code.summary: parseCodexLayer implements commands behavior in src/commands/agent/setup.ts; see the linked area guide for state, capability and failure rules.

code.name: PowerShellWindowsAclProtector.protectAndVerify
code.summary: Asks the Windows protection helper to establish and verify user-only credential access; failure is propagated rather than weakening protection.

code.name: PROVIDER_NAME_PATTERN
code.summary: Defines the accepted provider-name syntax used to validate local domain identifiers; it does not resolve or call a remote provider.

code.name: canTransitionSessionState
code.summary: Checks whether a proposed local Session state transition is legal before orchestration stores the new state.

code.name: OPERATION_ACTIONS
code.summary: Defines the allowed local Operation actions for lifecycle, execution and source work; validation rejects unknown action values.

code.name: SandboxSpecSchema
code.summary: Defines the validated sandbox specification and constraints used by configuration and provider contracts; validation does not prove hosted admission.

code.name: encodeHelperEventFrame
code.summary: Encodes one bounded helper event frame using the request framing format.

code.name: ExecutionService.start
code.summary: Validates the selected execution target, starts the helper protocol and separates command completion from infrastructure or cancellation outcomes.

code.name: createMetadataClient
code.summary: Issuer-bound metadata access does not depend on a selected hosted project.

code.name: effectiveMaxSandboxesPerSession
code.summary: Derives the effective sandbox count from provider capability information instead of assuming a generic specification is supported.

code.name: CreateSandboxRequestSchema
code.summary: Validates provider create input and request context at the local contract boundary; actual implementations enforce their advertised capabilities.

code.name: FakeSandboxProvider.create
code.summary: Creates a deterministic local fake-provider sandbox record for validation. It is not evidence of a live hosted sandbox deployment.

code.name: isTerminalOperationState
code.summary: Identifies terminal hosted Operation states for polling and reconciliation; pending/running states require another observation.

code.name: ExclusiveFileLock.#acquire
code.summary: Claims an exclusive local lock with bounded contention and ownership-aware stale recovery; cancellation and timeout do not permit an unlocked update.

code.name: LocalTransferAdapter.recover
code.summary: Recovers a local transfer using its durable journal: never promotes staged content or removes an ambiguous backup; restores the original target or proven absence.

code.name: collectExecutionEvents.fetchEventPage
code.summary: Fetch at most 100 events by default and validate the public page before ingest. Non-success responses map to typed client errors.

code.name: collectExecutionEvents.ingestPage
code.summary: Sort by sequence, skip duplicates, report stream-labelled output/progress and persist the next cursor checkpoint.

code.name: collectExecutionEvents.drainRemainingEvents
code.summary: Drain remaining events before terminal fallback result; reset invalid cursor, stop on terminal/exhaustion or a failed best-effort page.

code.name: collectExecutionEvents.readExecution
code.summary: Retry transient execution reads with Retry-After/backoff inside the original deadline; invalid representations and permanent errors fail.

code.name: collectExecutionEvents.readResult
code.summary: Read and validate terminal result with bounded retries. Deadline expiry returns OPERATION_TIMEOUT, not proof that remote work stopped.

code.name: representationFor
code.summary: Choose the manifest-pinned representation, otherwise requested or detected hooks layout; ownership keeps migration from duplicating hooks.

code.name: buildFragmentDrift
code.summary: Compare current owned fragments and file hashes with the manifest; report drift rather than silently replacing unrelated content.

code.name: removeMatchingGroups
code.summary: Remove only matching owned groups and preserve all unrelated hook groups; setup records the resulting repairs.

code.name: failedSetup
code.summary: Return a failed setup plan with zero changes, validation errors and remediation. Unsupported settings cannot become an apply plan.

journeys.name: Sign in from the CLI
journeys.summary: Sign in from the CLI: local preparation, public API or filesystem effects, and confirmed completion.

steps.story: Generate PKCE and state, bind 127.0.0.1 on a random port and open the browser authorization page; the listener accepts only one matching callback.

on_failure.story: Wrong or replayed state is rejected; cancellation and timeout close the listener without storing tokens.
Browser launch failure prints the authorization URL; callback timeout/wrong state fails login and finally closes the listener.

steps.story: Exchange the authorization code with its original verifier; validate the response before persisting credentials under the auth state lock.
Store bearer material through the credential port and non-secret metadata separately; a failed metadata commit rolls back the prior generation.

on_failure.story: If metadata commit fails, restore the prior credential/metadata pair under the gate. Failed restoration returns INVALID_STATE.

journeys.name: Start a box from the CLI
journeys.summary: Start a box from the CLI: local preparation, public API or filesystem effects, and confirmed completion.

steps.story: The lifecycle checks selected local Session state. A resumable Session is reconciled; otherwise creation saves a local operation before the request.
The hosted provider sends `createSession` with an idempotency key and retains the returned running operation for bounded recovery.

on_failure.story: A lost create reply leaves the saved operation/spec and stable key. Rerun start to reconcile the same local create intent. Return only validated state.

steps.story: Poll the operation with Retry-After and a default 5-minute deadline; terminal success is checked against the hosted Session before local state becomes active.

on_failure.story: A timeout preserves recoverable Session evidence and returns OPERATION_TIMEOUT; it does not pretend the server cancelled the create.
Five-minute wait expiry or permanent server failure reports a typed error and retains recovery evidence; it cannot certify remote absence.

journeys.name: Push local files to the box
journeys.summary: Push local files to the box: local preparation, public API or filesystem effects, and confirmed completion.

steps.story: Hosted push scans the folder, excluding sensitive/unsafe paths; rejects remote deletion, files over 64 KiB, more than 100 files or more than 512 KiB total.
Encode and hash an archive capped at 1 MiB; list verified receipts to avoid replaying an obsolete snapshot after an A→B→A change.
Create a `source manifest` with content and lineage-derived idempotency keys; the hosted Session must still accept source work.
Upload checksum-verified chunks, retrying a retryable failure at most 3 times; a 409 is accepted only when the returned chunk checksum matches.

on_failure.story: Only retryable chunk failures retry, at most 3 attempts. Accept conflict only if the receipt checksum matches; otherwise preserve the failure.

steps.story: Verify the complete source and poll a returned apply operation on a 1-second healthy interval within a default 5-minute deadline.

on_failure.story: Incomplete source or checksum mismatch returns a typed integrity failure. Success requires a matching manifest, checksum and chunk count.
A wrong manifest/checksum/chunk count fails receipt verification. Deadline preserves remote operation identity; it does not claim source applied.

journeys.name: Run a command from the CLI
journeys.summary: Run a command from the CLI: local preparation, public API or filesystem effects, and confirmed completion.

steps.story: Resolve the selected Session and provider capabilities; the execution service starts the helper with a validated request and bounded output protocol.
The hosted provider submits `createExecution` under an idempotency key and retains the returned pending execution handle.
Collect output by cursor and increasing sequence, skipping duplicates; after bounded stream failures the collector polls until its deadline.

on_failure.story: Reset an invalid cursor; after more than 3 event failures fall back to state/result polling within the original deadline. Nonretryable errors fail immediately.

steps.story: Read the terminal result and emit the command exit code. Interrupt or timeout requests remote cancellation before reporting its local outcome.

on_failure.story: A transport timeout is not proof the remote command stopped. Cancellation must converge to a terminal result or surface a typed failure.
Interrupt/timeout requests cancellation. Unconfirmed remote completion remains a typed failure; a local deadline cannot prove the command stopped.

journeys.name: A coding agent's command runs in the box
journeys.summary: A coding agent's command runs in the box: local preparation, public API or filesystem effects, and confirmed completion.

steps.story: A `PreToolUse` event reaches the owned adapter hook. Guard rules decide whether the command may run in the selected Session.
The hook invokes ocbox exec with a 570000 ms remote deadline inside the configured 600-second hook timeout, leaving a 30-second decision margin.
After the remote result the hook emits a blocking `deny` decision so the covered command is not repeated locally; guard refusal also emits a deny.

on_failure.story: Setup checks pinned versions and capability gates; unsupported configurations fail before editing an agent settings file.

journeys.name: Destroy a box from the CLI
journeys.summary: Destroy a box from the CLI: local preparation, public API or filesystem effects, and confirmed completion.

steps.story: Load the selected Session under its local project identity and record a pending destroy operation before dispatch.
Send destroySession with its idempotency key and poll the operation under the lifecycle deadline.

on_failure.story: If destroy/poll fails, retain the pending operation and mapping. Confirmation is required before dropping local binding state.

steps.story: Confirm the hosted Session has been deleted before removing its local mapping; a lost reply remains recoverable instead of becoming false success or a hidden error.

on_failure.story: A server destroy still pending returns a typed failure; retaining the mapping allows a later retry and reconciliation.

journeys.name: Refresh CLI tokens
journeys.summary: Refresh CLI tokens: local preparation, public API or filesystem effects, and confirmed completion.

steps.story: A credential approaching expiry is checked against issuer, client, audience and scope metadata while the cross-process auth state lock is held.
Rotate through `exchangeCliToken`. Another process adopts a newer generation rather than reusing the superseded refresh token.

on_failure.story: Revoked/reused refresh credentials require sign-in. Compare-delete only the failing generation so a newer concurrent login survives.

steps.story: Replace the matching credential generation; replay-safe HTTP requests can retry once after a 401, while unsafe mutations surface the failure.

on_failure.story: Revoked or reused refresh material clears the matching generation and returns `AUTH_REQUIRED`; another process's newer login is retained.

journeys.name: Inspect CLI authentication
journeys.summary: Inspect CLI authentication: local preparation, public API or filesystem effects, and confirmed completion.

steps.story: Load auth metadata and its credential reference under the state lock; tokens are never printed.
Verify identity, issuer, audience, scopes and expiry against the local `auth.json` binding and its referenced credential material.
Emit only logged-in and expiry facts; unsafe or inconsistent state returns INVALID_STATE rather than a misleading status.

journeys.name: Sign the CLI out
journeys.summary: Sign the CLI out: local preparation, public API or filesystem effects, and confirmed completion.

steps.story: Acquire `auth.state.lock` and load the current credential generation before server revocation or local cleanup.
Attempt public token revocation; this network effect is followed by local cleanup even when the request fails.
Clear both local stores and report cleanup failures as INVALID_STATE; secret token values never enter command output.

journeys.name: Resume a stopped box
journeys.summary: Resume a stopped box: local preparation, public API or filesystem effects, and confirmed completion.

steps.story: Validate the local Session state and save a pending lifecycle operation before calling the hosted API.
Send the requested mutation with an idempotency key; capability or Session state refusal returns a typed error.

on_failure.story: Unsupported capability fails before mutation. A lost reply leaves the saved operation/key for the same lifecycle action to reconcile.

steps.story: Poll and reconcile the hosted Session before saving the resulting local state; a deadline failure preserves recovery evidence.

journeys.name: Pause a box
journeys.summary: Pause a box: local preparation, public API or filesystem effects, and confirmed completion.

steps.story: Validate the local Session state and save a pending lifecycle operation before calling the hosted API.
Send the requested mutation with an idempotency key; capability or Session state refusal returns a typed error.

on_failure.story: Unsupported capability fails before mutation. A lost reply leaves the saved operation/key for the same lifecycle action to reconcile.

steps.story: Poll and reconcile the hosted Session before saving the resulting local state; a deadline failure preserves recovery evidence.

journeys.name: Stop a box
journeys.summary: Stop a box: local preparation, public API or filesystem effects, and confirmed completion.

steps.story: Validate the local Session state and save a pending lifecycle operation before calling the hosted API.
Send the requested mutation with an idempotency key; capability or Session state refusal returns a typed error.

on_failure.story: Unsupported capability fails before mutation. A lost reply leaves the saved operation/key for the same lifecycle action to reconcile.

steps.story: Poll and reconcile the hosted Session before saving the resulting local state; a deadline failure preserves recovery evidence.

journeys.name: Inspect a Session
journeys.summary: Inspect the selected local Session and verify its mapped hosted sandbox without replacing it.

steps.story: Resolve --session or activeSessionId under the current project; missing local identity fails before a hosted request.
Read the mapped sandbox through getSession; a missing mapping is SANDBOX_NOT_FOUND error. A destroyed or unbound local Session returns its local view.

on_failure.story: A stale/foreign mapping is SANDBOX_NOT_FOUND; failed reads do not replace the selected Session.

steps.story: Emit the saved local Session plus observed sandbox state; status does not create a Session or automatically repair a failed lifecycle action.

journeys.name: List local Sessions
journeys.summary: List saved local Session views; listing does not enumerate all hosted Sessions.

steps.story: Load this project’s lifecycle state and sort saved Sessions by createdAt; an empty state produces an empty list.
Build each view from saved state: bindings/sandbox/operation records. No hosted listSessions request runs in LifecycleService.list.

on_failure.story: Invalid saved schema fails the read; local listing cannot silently hide corruption as no Sessions.

steps.story: Emit local views including active selection and pending operation evidence; a corrupt state fails validation instead of becoming an empty list.

journeys.name: Select a Session
journeys.summary: Select an existing local Session for later commands.

steps.story: Parse the requested Session ID and load its saved local record under this project; an unknown identity is rejected.
Update activeSessionId under the local state lock. This chooses a Session; it does not start the box or mutate its remote workspace.

on_failure.story: Missing local identity is rejected; lock conflict leaves activeSessionId unchanged and returns OPERATION_CONFLICT error.

steps.story: Emit the selected Session view. A lock conflict reports OPERATION_CONFLICT; no hosted lifecycle request is needed to select it. Return only validated state.

journeys.name: Inspect source differences
journeys.summary: Plan differences on supported local providers; hosted diff is refused.

steps.story: Resolve the selected Session and sync roots. Hosted provider returns CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED before attempting a two-sided scan.
For a local provider, reject unresolved recovery; require no unresolved transfer/baseline recovery, scan both sides under ignore/path rules and build the three-way plan.

on_failure.story: Pending recovery, unsafe paths or unreadable source produces an explicit error before any transfer.

steps.story: Emit conflicts, exclusions, collisions and proposed operations without applying them. Unsafe paths are rejected; no --force bypass exists.

journeys.name: Recover an interrupted local sync
journeys.summary: Restore interrupted local transfer evidence without promoting staged content.

steps.story: Hosted recover returns CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED. For a local provider acquire the sync lock before inspecting recovery journals.
Visit remote then local target, recover any interrupted transfer, and reconcile a pending verified baseline. Ambiguous backup evidence stops recovery.

on_failure.story: An ambiguous backup/journal rejects recovery and retains evidence; another transfer stays blocked.

steps.story: Report recovered and operationId; unresolved failures retain journal/backup evidence and block later sync rather than discarding it.

journeys.name: Cancel a command
journeys.summary: Cancel a command: local preparation, public API or filesystem effects, and confirmed completion.

steps.story: Resolve the selected Session and locate its current hosted execution; absent work is reported as a typed error.
Request `cancelExecution` and continue observing until the hosted result is terminal; a deadline is not proof the command stopped.

on_failure.story: If the 30000-ms default wait expires, report incomplete convergence and retain the execution identity; timeout is not successful cancellation.

steps.story: Emit the confirmed cancellation outcome; a deadline failure reports that convergence is incomplete.

journeys.name: Install a coding-agent adapter
journeys.summary: Install a coding-agent adapter: local preparation, public API or filesystem effects, and confirmed completion.

steps.story: Inspect agent version, supported configuration layers and project trust; unsupported or untrusted settings fail with an error before a write.
Plan changes only to owned `PreToolUse` hook fragments, record backups and expected content hashes, then apply after rechecking file drift.

on_failure.story: Untrusted project, unsupported schema/version or missing usable Session returns a failed plan with zero settings changes.

steps.story: Write an ownership manifest so doctor/remove can identify only this adapter; a partial write fails and rolls back from the saved content.

on_failure.story: Rechecked file drift aborts apply. Partial writes roll back saved content; failed rollback remains an explicit error.

journeys.name: Inspect adapter drift
journeys.summary: Inspect the installed adapter and report drift without repairing settings.

steps.story: Detect the selected agent/version and configuration paths, including project trust and supported schema; malformed options fail before inspection.
Read ownership manifest and compare owned fragments/content hashes. Report missing/modified/duplicate fragments and capability blockers.

on_failure.story: Unreadable/corrupt settings appear as failed checks and remediation; no repair is written by doctor.

steps.story: Emit structured status checks and remediation; doctor does not apply a repair plan or overwrite user hooks.

journeys.name: Remove owned adapter settings
journeys.summary: Remove only settings whose ownership can be proven from the adapter manifest.

steps.story: Load the agent’s ownership manifest and current settings; unsupported layers or unsafe paths are rejected before a write.
Plan removal of recorded hook fragments while retaining unrelated settings; verify file expected-state hashes/expected content immediately before apply.

on_failure.story: Ownership ambiguity or file drift rejects destructive edits; partial apply attempts rollback and reports failure.

steps.story: Codex prints the removal plan unless --yes requests apply; recheck expected files before edits. Partial apply attempts rollback and reports a failure; unrelated hooks remain owned by the user.

journeys.name: Manage project metadata
journeys.summary: Read and mutate project metadata through the public contract, independently of sandbox selection.

steps.story: Parse identifiers, names (1–200 characters) and list limit (1–100); build an issuer-bound authenticated client without requiring a selected sandbox.

Send one project list/get/create/update request. Pagination is caller-driven; mutation uses the supplied retry key or a new UUID, so cross-invocation replay requires retaining --idempotency-retry key.

on_failure.story: Non-success API status or strict response-schema failure becomes a typed error with request identity; no unknown response bytes enter output.

steps.story: Validate a strict public response schema: create expects 201, other actions 200. Preserve request/replay metadata; unsafe response fields or transport parsing failures become typed errors.

journeys.name: Manage environment metadata
journeys.summary: Read and mutate environment metadata through the public contract, independently of sandbox selection.

steps.story: Parse identifiers, names (1–200 characters) and list limit (1–100); build an issuer-bound authenticated client without requiring a selected sandbox.

Send one environment list/get/create/update request. Pagination is caller-driven; mutation uses the supplied retry key or a new UUID, so cross-invocation replay requires retaining --idempotency-retry key.

on_failure.story: Empty update or invalid selected flag fails validation; authentication/ownership/server failures stay typed and retain request identity.

steps.story: Validate a strict public response schema: create expects 201, other actions 200. Preserve request/replay metadata; unsafe response fields or transport parsing failures become typed errors.

journeys.name: Initialize project configuration
journeys.summary: Create or validate project config, completing hosted project onboarding when needed.

steps.story: Resolve config and provider: explicit flag, existing config, or hosted after login/fake otherwise. Parse existing config before changes; invalid state fails early.
If hosted project ID is absent, page project names for this directory, reject a repeated cursor, or create a project. This onboarding changes metadata, never creates a box.

on_failure.story: Repeated pagination cursor, authentication failure or invalid project response fails onboarding. A config write failure cannot be reported as successful initialization.

steps.story: Revalidate config, update existing content only when changed, or create exclusively with mode 0600 and sync. Filesystem error fails init; success returns created or validated.

journeys.name: Pull source on a local provider
journeys.summary: Copy remote-only changes into local files on supported providers, with explicit deletion and recovery gates.

steps.story: Resolve selected Session, local target and provider workspace. Hosted pull returns CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED before any local file changes.
On a local provider, acquire the sync lock and build the three-way plan. Reject conflicts, unsafe paths and unresolved recovery; deletions require --delete and confirmation/--yes.
Stage and journal each approved transfer, verify target before commit and publish baseline only from verified results. Partial failure retains recoverable evidence.

on_failure.story: An interrupted target move retains the backup and journal; run sync recover before another transfer. Recovery rejects promotion of staged content.

journeys.name: Inspect provider capabilities
journeys.summary: Show the configured provider and declared capabilities without claiming that every interface is deployed.

steps.story: Load and validate project config; resolve the provider registry entry. An unknown provider fails configuration before any command is dispatched.
Ask the selected adapter for declared capabilities and render its bounded public view. An unsupported capability remains a refusal at the operation boundary.

on_failure.story: Invalid config/provider selection returns a typed error; a declared method alone cannot make an unavailable hosted capability succeed.
